dialect.detail: JMA ORCA (日医標準レセプトソフト) medical receipt system, Project ORCA. Uses GnuCOBOL with JMA-specific COPY members and subprogram conventions.
evidence: Japanese comments referencing JMA Open Source License

purpose.domain_detail: JMA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - API linkage module for deletion/termination of income/payment (収納) records
purpose.summary: This program is an API linkage subprogram (deletion variant, S99 suffix) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It validates API parameters by querying tbl_api_para, checks state and input, calls ORCGSSUB04 to terminate the API session, and writes an XML response. It handles date arithmetic via ORCSDAY and machine date retrieval via ORCSMCNDATE.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY members (14 copybooks) for data structures
LINKAGE SECTION with SCRAREA, INCOMEREQ-AREA, SPA-AREA
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary DB cursor abstraction (MCP-TABLE, MCP-PATHNAME, 910-DBCLOSECURSOR-SEC)
Date arithmetic via external subprogram ORCSDAY
SPA-AREA common area pattern typical of ORCA
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; the 900-XML-WRITE-SEC section is cut off mid-statement. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. No COMP-3 usage despite financial domain, consistent with ORCA coding style. Fixed format confirmed by max_line_length 74 and long_lines_over_72 of only 5.
